blockingFindings.title: R2 duplicate identity rejection is not covered
blockingFindings.rationale: R2 explicitly requires repeated identity rejection before execution or state mutation, and R9 explicitly lists duplicate identity rejection as required spec-local coverage.
blockingFindings.issue: The coverage artifact claims R2 coverage for repeated phase/task/tree/digest identity rejection, but the tests only cover stale tree SHA and caller-supplied digest rejection. No test attempts to register the same canonical evidence identity as a new mutation/provider execution boundary and asserts rejection before state mutation.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local test that creates or registers an already-seen phase/task/tree/digest identity and asserts the CLI/store rejects it without mutating canonical evidence or flow-state bytes.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R2 explicitly requires repeated identity rejection before execution or state mutation, and R9 explicitly lists duplicate identity rejection as required spec-local coverage.

blockingFindings.title: R2 unchanged-bytes rejection guarantee is not covered
blockingFindings.rationale: R2 makes unchanged canonical evidence files and flow-state bytes part of the required behavior for all pre-mutation rejections.
blockingFindings.issue: The tests do not assert that rejection paths leave canonical evidence files and flow-state bytes unchanged. The stale tree and caller digest assertions only check thrown errors.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Extend rejection tests to snapshot relevant canonical evidence and flow-state bytes before the rejected operation and assert they are unchanged after rejection.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R2 makes unchanged canonical evidence files and flow-state bytes part of the required behavior for all pre-mutation rejections.

blockingFindings.title: R3 REJECTED-before-exhaustion behavior is not covered
blockingFindings.rationale: R3 requires REJECTED behavior before exhaustion, and R9 explicitly requires separate fixtures for REJECTED before and at remediation exhaustion.
blockingFindings.issue: The tests cover exhausted REJECTED moving to acceptance, but do not cover REJECTED before semantic remediation budget exhaustion consuming only the semantic budget and permitting remediation rather than rerunning the same evidence review.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a fixture for REJECTED with semanticAttempts below semanticMaxAttempts and assert the expected remediation operation/budget behavior without tooling budget consumption or duplicate review execution.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R3 requires REJECTED behavior before exhaustion, and R9 explicitly requires separate fixtures for REJECTED before and at remediation exhaustion.

blockingFindings.title: R4 result-recording failure is not covered
blockingFindings.rationale: R4 explicitly includes result-recording failures in the tooling error contract.
blockingFindings.issue: The tooling failure stage loop covers startup, communication, parse, post_hook, canonical_write, and projection, but omits result-recording failure even though R4 requires it to persist as TOOLING_ERROR with attempt data and no semantic budget consumption.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a result-recording failure fixture and assert TOOLING_ERROR stage/attempt data, no review findings, and no semantic remediation budget consumption.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R4 explicitly includes result-recording failures in the tooling error contract.

blockingFindings.title: R9 PASS fixture is missing
blockingFindings.rationale: R9 explicitly requires spec-local tests with a separate PASS fixture.
blockingFindings.issue: R9 requires separate fixtures for PASS, ADVISORY, and REJECTED states. The executable regression fixtures exercise ADVISORY and some REJECTED resolution, but no PASS review execution/result fixture validates completed review behavior with no findings.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a PASS fixture that normalizes or resolves a PASS review result and asserts no findings, completed exactly once, no rerun, and no acceptance handoff findings.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R9 explicitly requires spec-local tests with a separate PASS fixture.

advisoryFindings.title: Malformed independent evidence cases could be more explicit
advisoryFindings.rationale: R5 has some boundary coverage through digest and idempotent registration tests, but clearer negative fixtures would make the acceptance intent easier to audit.
advisoryFindings.improvement: Add focused invalid-document cases for missing provenance fields, malformed disposition/finding consistency, and oversized input bounds.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: R5 has some boundary coverage through digest and idempotent registration tests, but clearer negative fixtures would make the acceptance intent easier to audit.
